name: dojo-lanes
description: Two agents writing one file clobber each other: the first writer holds the file while it runs, a second running agent is refused, and fan-outs get the shared contract.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What happens when a running subagent writes a file another running subagent holds: lock (refuse the write, default), warn (allow it, log once), or off.

attach_contract.title: Attach contract
attach_contract.description: Append a short note to a subagent's prompt pointing at the shared contract file (when one exists) and explaining lanes.

contract_paths.title: Contract paths
contract_paths.description: Comma-separated paths checked in order for a frozen shared-decisions file. Relative paths are under the session directory.
